pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired - service=inference-queue-eu-west - symptom=5xx+latency spike. PD: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345
micah: ack :white_check_mark: taking first responder. checking kvcache and worker pool.
tara: standing by if you need a hand or handoff @micah
micah: quick tail from embedder logs shows repeated evictions and OOM-ish traces. restarting embedder-worker-3 in eu-west-1 now
micah: ```kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/embedder-worker --context=prod-eu``` 
pagerbot: Escalation rule: after 5m with >10% error the alert escalates to eng-infra. created incident bridge: https://zoom.us/j/99999999
zach: adding temporary routing rule to prefer dedicated-eu pool to reduce tail latency. applying policy now.
zach: ```redwoodctl route set --service embedder --prefer-pool dedicated-eu --reason "emergency drain"``` 
micah: restart triggered, pods are terminating/starting. CPU on embedder pool trending down. queue depth shrinking (~40%->15%).
jess: CS note: customers might see higher latency and occasional 502s. drafting PSA and pinged support channel. ETA for comms 10m :memo:
micah: metrics: 5xx went from 12% -> 3% since restart started. continuing to watch, ETA stable ~5m.
tara: if micah needs to step out, request handoff. otherwise I'll standby and monitor dashboards.
micah: handing off in 8m to @tara with logs and runbook. posting quick runbook excerpt below:
micah: ```# runbook excerpt
1) check embedder pod logs: kubectl -n inference logs deploy/embedder-worker -c embedder
2) if eviction loop present, bump kvcache size: kubectl patch cm inference-config -p '{"data":{"kvcache_size":"6G"}}'
3) restart deployment and monitor 5xx rate
``` 
support-bot: Notified #support and queued CS tickets for impacted customers.
micah: leaving continuous monitoring on. feel free to DM for handoff. :eyes:
tara: taking over at T+12m. will post updates every 5m and escalate to infra if markers reappear.
pagerbot: Note: this thread will auto-close when PD incident resolves. Ping the bot to keep open.
